AboutBased in Seoul

Han Xi is an industrial designer and UX researcher based in Seoul, with academic and project experience in China and Korea.

Currently completing a master’s degree in Industrial Design at Seoul National University, I work across user research, data synthesis, product development and visual communication.

My background in China and Korea helps me notice how the same product can be understood differently across languages, habits and cultural expectations.
